capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists 53.0 kWh nominal for the IONIQ 6 Standard Range (MY23-25, Europe); Hyundai Europe press kit also gives 53 kWh. Treated as gross; same pack as the US SE Standard Range.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists 50.0 kWh usable for the 53 kWh European IONIQ 6 Standard Range (MY23-25), same pack. (evspecs.org shows 58/53 and GreenCarsCompare 54 usable: conflict, not used.)

chemistry.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists NMC cathode for the 53 kWh European IONIQ 6.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Hyundai describes the IONIQ 6 as 800 V (both packs, Hyundai Europe press kit); EVDB lists 480 V nominal for this smaller pack, so class rests on the maker's architecture statement, not the pack voltage.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Hyundai US launch release for the 2023 IONIQ 6 (77.4 kWh) states a battery heater that starts when a charging stop is entered in navigation and can be warmed manually via the app; the CE1 (IONIQ 6) 2024 US manual states a manual Battery Conditioning Mode and automatic operation when the battery is cold or the scheduled climate is on (it does not itself state the DC-destination trigger, does not name the model, and says the function needs a battery heater). A battery heater on the Standard Range is not shown on any page; assumed because the same model and charging system carry the feature across packs.
Estimated: companion to the value from src-hyundai-ww-ioniq6-la-2022 (manual control from this CE1 US owner's manual page).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists max DC 150 kW via CCS for the 53 kWh European IONIQ 6 Standard Range (MY23-25); Hyundai states only 18 min on 350 kW. Same pack.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 10.9 kW onboard charger stated for the 2023 US IONIQ 6 (77.4 kWh); EVDB lists 11 kW for the Standard Range too. Same car and charger across packs assumed.

published_10_80_min.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists 18 min 10-80 % for the 53 kWh Standard Range (about 120 kW average, European car); Hyundai only states 18 min for the IONIQ 6 on a 350 kW charger (77.4 kWh pack release).
